# George Washington — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("When and where was George Washington?", "1789-1797, 1st"),
    ("What is George Washington known for?", "Revolutionary general"),
    ("What is when/where?", "1789-1797, 1st"),
    ("What is what happened?", "Revolutionary general"),
    ("What is significance?", "Farewell Address; no third term"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
